name: AURAS Pay for WooCommerce
author: Auras Pay

sections.description:
AURAS Pay for WooCommerce enables your online store to accept cryptocurrency payments seamlessly. Built on top of the powerful AURAS Pay platform, this plugin provides a secure, fast, and user-friendly way to accept crypto payments from customers worldwide.

Supported Cryptocurrencies

  • Solana (SOL) – Fast and low-cost transactions
  • USD Coin (USDC) – Stablecoin pegged to USD
  • Bitcoin (BTC) – The original cryptocurrency
  • Ethereum (ETH) – Smart contract platform

Key Features

  • ✅ Multi-Cryptocurrency Support – Accept SOL, USDC, BTC, and ETH
  • ✅ QR Code Payments – Customers can scan and pay with mobile wallets
  • ✅ Real-time Verification – Automatic payment detection and verification
  • ✅ Webhook Notifications – Instant payment status updates
  • ✅ Automatic Currency Conversion – Convert from any fiat currency to crypto
  • ✅ Non-Custodial – You maintain full control of your funds
  • ✅ Detailed Logging – Debug mode for troubleshooting
  • ✅ Mobile Optimized – Perfect payment experience on all devices
  • ✅ Secure – Industry-standard security practices

How It Works

  1. Customer selects AURAS Pay at checkout
  2. Chooses their preferred cryptocurrency
  3. Scans QR code or clicks to open wallet
  4. Confirms payment in their wallet app
  5. Order is automatically completed upon payment confirmation

Why Choose AURAS Pay?

  • Fast Transactions – Payments confirmed in seconds
  • Low Fees – Significantly lower than credit card fees
  • Global Reach – Accept payments from anywhere in the world
  • No Chargebacks – Cryptocurrency transactions are final
  • Privacy Focused – No personal information required from customers
  • 24/7 Availability – Blockchain never sleeps

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • AURAS Pay account and API key (Sign up here)
  • SSL certificate (recommended for production)

Getting Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Sign up for an AURAS Pay account at auraspay.com
  3. Get your API key from the AURAS Pay dashboard
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > AURAS Pay
  5. Enter your API key and configure settings
  6. Enable the payment gateway
  7. Start accepting crypto payments!

Documentation & Support

  • Plugin Documentation
  • API Documentation
  • Video Tutorials
  • Support Forum
  • Contact Us

Developer Friendly

This plugin is built with developers in mind:

  • Clean, well-documented code
  • WordPress coding standards
  • Extensive hooks and filters
  • REST API integration
  • Webhook support
  • Debug logging

Privacy Policy

AURAS Pay for WooCommerce does not collect or store any personal information from your customers. All payment processing is handled by AURAS Pay. Please review the AURAS Pay Privacy Policy for more information.

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services:

  • AURAS Pay API – For payment processing (Terms | Privacy)
  • CoinGecko API – For cryptocurrency price data (optional) (Terms | Privacy)
  • ExchangeRate API – For fiat currency conversion (optional) (Terms)

Credits

  • Developed by the AURAS Pay Team
  • Icons by Tabler Icons
  • Cryptocurrency price data by CoinGecko

Support

For support, please visit:
* Documentation: https://auraspay.com/docs
* Support Forum: https://auraspay.com/support
* Email: support@auraspay.com
* Discord: https://discord.gg/auraspay
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “AURAS Pay for WooCommerce”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Click “Activate Plugin”

Configuration

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  2. Click on “AURAS Pay”
  3. Check “Enable AURAS Pay”
  4. Enter your API Key (get it from AURAS Pay Dashboard)
  5. Configure your preferred settings:
    • Default cryptocurrency
    • Payment timeout
    • Currency conversion source
  6. Copy the Webhook URL and add it to your AURAS Pay dashboard
  7. Save changes
  8. Test the payment flow with test API credentials
sections.faq:
Do I need a cryptocurrency wallet?

Yes, you need a cryptocurrency wallet to receive payments. You can use any wallet that supports the cryptocurrencies you want to accept (Phantom for Solana, MetaMask for Ethereum, etc.).

How do I get an API key?

Sign up for a free account at auraspay.com, complete the verification process, and generate your API key from the dashboard.

Are there any transaction fees?

AURAS Pay charges a small fee per transaction. Check our pricing page for current rates. Blockchain network fees also apply.

How long does it take to receive payments?

Payments are typically confirmed within seconds to a few minutes, depending on the blockchain network. Solana is usually the fastest (1-2 seconds).

Can I accept multiple cryptocurrencies?

Yes! Customers can choose from SOL, USDC, BTC, or ETH at checkout.

What happens if a payment fails?

If a payment fails or expires, the order is automatically cancelled, and the customer can try again or choose a different payment method.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes, the plugin follows WordPress and WooCommerce security best practices. All API communications are encrypted, and webhook signatures are verified.

Can I test before going live?

Absolutely! Use test API credentials from your AURAS Pay dashboard to test the payment flow without processing real transactions.

Do you offer refunds?

Cryptocurrency transactions are irreversible. If you need to refund a customer, you’ll need to send them cryptocurrency manually from your wallet.

What if I need help?

Contact our support team at support@auraspay.com or visit our support forum.

  • Comprehensive admin settings
